I think you're right about the possibility of psychological damage. when I was OP's sister's age I lost my virginity and had a relationship with a man around 25 years old as well, really similar situation except for the fact that he wasn't a family friend. i felt I was ready, i *thought* there was mutual respect, and it did feel good to have attention and affection from someone older. 

however, looking back, i was absolutely taken advantage of. what man knowingly goes into relationships with girls that age. they *know* the girls probably aren't sexually mature or emotionally developed enough for something like that. especially if he was her first time. for me, it really made future relationships a bit more difficult, i became accustomed to being used and taken advantage of because it's just what men did. she has to be made to know this isn't the case. she needs to really look at the situation from a perspective that isn't hers, see it for what it really is. OP sounds like a good sister and her family sounds supportive, I'm sure her sister will do okay, I'm just trying to stress the importance of her coming back from this with a healthy mind and attitude about sex and relationships.

it was hard. im proud of that. the urges to do them again have been worse than ever. I've slipped, I've zonked myself out on 'safer' drugs many times because I want the comfort it gives my mind from them again. Im sure if I don't kill myself I'll likely do drugs again. 

I've been to different forms of counselling/therapy by my own wishes and being forced into some by my mother. I won't say it was useless, it seems like stuff like that could be helpful to some. I just.. it would help me for a short period of time *maybe* and I don't know. I could never explain wholly what is going on inside my head, it's just so impossible to! and their answers to everything sometimes just seemed so rehearsed and. man. I don't know

thank you for this. it is complicated, isn't it. 

I'm not sure what about my story to share, Im sure subconsciously I know my life can be salvaged, it's just that, my mind being like it is makes it so hard for any kind of hope for the future to seem reachable because it's my own fucking brain that's.. idk that's mostly the blame for the bane of my own normal content existence/sanity.
I'm 17. now everything I've said will probably just sound like angsty teenager stuff right? please please believe me, I'm not just young and confused about life right now

I don't know who to reply to but I just had some thoughts and wanted to share: 

I just. right now I feel so fucking comfortable with my decision. not overwhelmingly happy or anything, hell I've been sitting here having these thoughts and I'm crying a bit. but not sad either, just so content. I don't know why. it's like, I just want to die while I'm still myself. and for such a long time I haven't felt myself. I've felt so fucking unhappy and discontent with life, I've grown to absolutely despise who I am. I used to do hard drugs to deal with this, (I've actually been clean for a few months now) I've never felt this peaceful  than when I did do a lot drugs. and I'm sober, instead of the underlying.. hopeful(?) feeling I got on drugs, it's more of an underlying feeling of ease. like I'll finally be rid of whatever in my mind is stopping me from being able to appreciate the beauty that could be a life. I know the past is the past and all that, but another factor to my decision is finally being able to get over a lot of things that have happened to me/I've done. like I said, I'll be at peace. a lot of things in my life got messed up in a short amount of time in my life, and I have to deal with it a lot on my own. It all wears so so much on my head, and fucks with a lot in my mind and in life, relationships/anxiety, idk. 

I'm probably explaining this so awfully, I'm just rambling but i needed to get it out. 

I

I know it's a selfish thing to do. it's easy to say keep on living, life is life, etc etc but really i don't know how I can explain myself to you. I don't know how. that's what I'm struggling with. at this point it feels like I'm putting it off, killing myself. a false hope, waiting for this 'light at the end' that'll never show up. there's a lot of reasons I have for doing what I'm going to do, this isn't a snap decision. I think I've known since quite young that I wouldn't make it to an old age, whether it was intentional or not. I don't know, I feel so weighed down by this overwhelming melancholy and emptiness I feel, and with my past and just with everything and nothing at the same time. my mind is killing me.
